한상진


관련해서 선주에게 회의 참석 요청을 한 결과 선주는 숙고 끝에 참석을 하지 않는 것이 낫다는 의견을 표시하였습니다.
그 이유는 선급과 조선소 디자인 회사가 같이 협의하는 자리에서 선주가 참석할 경우 선주가 불필요한 책임을 가질 수 있다라는 부분에 대해서 우려를 하였습니다.
선주는 내가 원하는 것은 오로지 현재 도면 승인 관련해서 이 프로젝트가 지연되고 있는 상황에서 도면 승인이 물론 한국의 도면 승인 권한이 없어서 싱가포르로 가는 것은 이해는 하지만 그리고 싱가포르 도면 승인 담당자가 이 프로젝트 말고 다른 프로젝트들도 동시에 진행하기 때문에 자리를 비울 수 어렵다는 것은 알고 있지만 현재 이 도연 승인 시점을 최대한 줄여야지 그 이후 bv 코리아 현장 검사관이 입회하에 이 검사를 마무리할 수 있는 부분이 있기 때문에 지금 현재 10억 원이 넘는 배상 관련 이슈가 지금 조선소 디자인 회사 선주 간에 논의가 되고 있는 이런 심각한 상황에서 선급에서 최소한

bv 레퓨테이션 향후 레퓨테이션을 감안하더라도 이 선주는 향후에도 계속해서 CTV를 발주할 여지가 있다라는 것을 참고하기 바라며 이선주는 PV 래퓨테이션 유지 차원에서라도 싱가폴 담당자가 다른 도면 승인 부분으로 업무적으로 부담은 있겠지만 이 지금 최종적으로 낙기가 계속해서 미루어지고 하루에도 많은 손실 금액이 발생하는 이런 상황에서 싱가포르 담당자가 한국에 방한하여 현장에서의 도면 승인을 최대한 단 시간 안에 마무리할 수 있도록 협의조치해 주는 것이 유일하게 선주가 비브에게 원하는 사항입니다.
따라서 싱가포르 도면 승인 부서에서는 이러한 요청 사항에 대해서 검토하여 의견을 주시면 대단히 감사하겠습니다.

**주제****:** RE: [URGENT] K-WIND Solution CTV Project - Request for Expedited Processing to Prevent Shipowner Losses Due to Classification Approval Delays

Dear all,

Regarding the above project, we are all well aware of the current project's construction progress. There are still unresolved comments that have not been addressed. Accordingly, the planned delivery schedule has been postponed.

Currently, the shipowner is only listening to the shipyard and design company and putting pressure on BV. Therefore, the shipowner's criticism may not be based on objective facts about the issue.

Regarding this matter, an operational reporting meeting was held today within BV Korea.

The conclusion of the meeting is that all future meetings with the shipyard and design company must necessarily include the shipowner and marketing team of BV Korea. By having the shipowner participate in the meetings, the aim is to enable the shipowner to listen to the conversations between BV, the shipyard, and the design company, and to help them perceive the facts more objectively. 

Therefore, please invite the shipowner and marketing manager(Mr. Sang-Jin HAN) to every meeting with BV, the shipyard, and the design company.

[@Sangjin HAN](mailto:sangjin.han@bureauveritas.com): Considering the aforementioned matters, I kindly request your cooperation to ensure that the shipowner can attend all future meetings.

Thanks.

Dear Mr. Han,

Well received your email and fully appreciate owner concern on the project.

SPO is putting up most effort & resource to ensure not just the earliest possible delivery but also compliance to BV rules. 

We 100% agree and supporting the request to have weekly meetings for the project until delivery. Should we expect Project leader to organize this weekly meeting with designer/yard & owner or SPO could take lead?

Would like to also appeal that the delay in delivery cannot be solely due to classification approval. To put thing in better context, please find current outstanding comments:

- TBDW - 54nos

- TBRS - 29nos(1/3 of are related to stability, and expect to close in final stability)

There are also separate discussion with BV Project leader on site installation issue(eg. Wrong anchor winch, smoke & fire division installation, shaft seal.....), which would have greater impact on delivery, and they are not related to design approval or BV survey. We are trying to assist project leader to resolve some of the site issues as well.

We have shared earlier that BV is dealing with designer that seems to be designing aluminium, catamaran vessel for first time. When SPO proposed structure reinforcement for a particular comment after many rounds of discussion and concluded that designer is not capable to address the issue, yard/owner would perceive that BV comments were only raised today. While in fact, the comment was raised much earlier. 

LPO2413342 is a typical example. Comment was first raised in Dec 2024, designer first justification came in Mar 2025 and many versions of calculations provided designer which unfortunately were assessed not to be reliable. Following snapshot recorded historic response and it did not include the online meetings we had with designer in between those replies. 

We had a teams call yesterday with the designer, with the support from Mr. Huh [@Ki-Soo HUH](mailto:ki-soo.huh@bureauveritas.com) from KPO and provided several reinforcement options to designer. We hope to close this topic by this Friday. Designer will also need to check and confirm with yard the feasibility of these options.
